# Sonic Bold

> Sonic Bold is a Google Ads specialist that works exclusively with plumbing companies.

Sonic Bold builds and manages high-intent Google Ads campaigns for plumbing contractors, then optimizes landing pages, call tracking, and conversion so more searches become booked jobs.

- Canonical site: https://www.sonicbold.com/
- Blog: https://www.sonicbold.com/blog
- Google Ads for plumbers: https://www.sonicbold.com/google-ads-for-plumbers
